scope: Scheduling and failure regressions for general desktop content
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none
verified_behaviors: Block invariance at 1/64/128/257/512 frames with 137 BPM non-integral bars: launch, mid-bar scene replacement, scene stop
Exact looped imported-range samples after replacement; MIDI voices released by the replacement
Control-queue saturation reports full; panic recovers; later controls apply
Deleting a playing track: next plan drops clip and scene slots; held notes end at render-owner stop
Missing media prepares silent; invalid content refused without replacing the existing plan
limits: Offline engine/controller checks; no backend or physical audio.
